mapper.select: SELECT host_id FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND host_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wc_chat_history( id, user_id, userPrompt, data, create_time, chat_id, tone_chat_id, yb_chat_id, db_chat_id, ty_chat_id, deepseek_chat_id, max_chat_id, metaso_chat_id, kimi_chat_id, baidu_chat_id, zhzd_chat_id ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{userPrompt}, #{data}, NOW(), #{chatId}, #{toneChatId}, #{ybChatId}, #{dbChatId}, #{tyChatId}, #{deepseekChatId}, #{maxChatId}, #{metasoChatId}, #{kimiChatId}, #{baiduChatId}, #{zhzdChatId} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE userPrompt = VALUES(userPrompt), data = VALUES(data), tone_chat_id = COALESCE(VALUES(tone_chat_id), tone_chat_id), yb_chat_id = COALESCE(VALUES(yb_chat_id), yb_chat_id), db_chat_id = COALESCE(VALUES(db_chat_id), db_chat_id), ty_chat_id = COALESCE(VALUES(ty_chat_id), ty_chat_id), deepseek_chat_id = COALESCE(VALUES(deepseek_chat_id), deepseek_chat_id), max_chat_id = COALESCE(VALUES(max_chat_id), max_chat_id), metaso_chat_id = COALESCE(VALUES(metaso_chat_id), metaso_chat_id), kimi_chat_id = COALESCE(VALUES(kimi_chat_id), kimi_chat_id), baidu_chat_id = COALESCE(VALUES(baidu_chat_id), baidu_chat_id), zhzd_chat_id = COALESCE(VALUES(zhzd_chat_id), zhzd_chat_id)
mapper.select:
SELECT id, userPrompt, data, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%c-%d %H:%i:%s') createTime, chat_id chatId, tone_chat_id toneChatId, yb_chat_id ybChatId, db_chat_id dbChatId, ty_chat_id tyChatId, deepseek_chat_id deepseekChatId, max_chat_id maxChatId, metaso_chat_id metasoChatId, kimi_chat_id kimiChatId, baidu_chat_id baiduChatId, zhzd_chat_id zhzdChatId FROM wc_chat_history WHERE user_id = #{userId}
AND userPrompt LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND deepseek_chat_id IS NOT NULL
AND yb_chat_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY create_time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT id, userPrompt, data, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%c-%d %H:%i:%s') createTime, chat_id chatId, tone_chat_id toneChatId, yb_chat_id ybChatId, db_chat_id dbChatId, ty_chat_id tyChatId, deepseek_chat_id deepseekChatId, max_chat_id maxChatId, metaso_chat_id metasoChatId, kimi_chat_id kimiChatId, baidu_chat_id baiduChatId, zhzd_chat_id zhzdChatId FROM wc_chat_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wc_playwright_draft( id, task_id, keyword, user_prompt, draft_content, ai_name, create_time, user_name, share_url, share_img_url, is_push ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{taskId}, #{keyword}, #{userPrompt}, #{draftContent}, #{aiName}, NOW(), #{userName}, #{shareUrl}, #{shareImgUrl}, COALESCE(#{isPush}, 0) )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wc_playwright_draft WHERE id = #{draftId} AND user_name = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id userId, userPrompt, data, chat_id chatId, tone_chat_id toneChatId, yb_chat_id ybChatId, db_chat_id dbChatId, ty_chat_id tyChatId, deepseek_chat_id deepseekChatId, max_chat_id maxChatId, metaso_chat_id metasoChatId, kimi_chat_id kimiChatId, baidu_chat_id baiduChatId, zhzd_chat_id zhzdChatId, create_time createTime FROM wc_chat_history WHERE id = #{sessionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE wc_chat_history SET data = #{data}, userPrompt = COALESCE(#{userPrompt}, userPrompt), chat_id = COALESCE(#{chatId}, chat_id), tone_chat_id = COALESCE(#{toneChatId}, tone_chat_id), yb_chat_id = COALESCE(#{ybChatId}, yb_chat_id), db_chat_id = COALESCE(#{dbChatId}, db_chat_id), ty_chat_id = COALESCE(#{tyChatId}, ty_chat_id), deepseek_chat_id = COALESCE(#{deepseekChatId}, deepseek_chat_id), max_chat_id = COALESCE(#{maxChatId}, max_chat_id), metaso_chat_id = COALESCE(#{metasoChatId}, metaso_chat_id), kimi_chat_id = COALESCE(#{kimiChatId}, kimi_chat_id), baidu_chat_id = COALESCE(#{baiduChatId}, baidu_chat_id), zhzd_chat_id = COALESCE(#{zhzdChatId}, zhzd_chat_id) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id userId, userPrompt, data, chat_id chatId, tone_chat_id toneChatId, yb_chat_id ybChatId, db_chat_id dbChatId, ty_chat_id tyChatId, deepseek_chat_id deepseekChatId, max_chat_id maxChatId, metaso_chat_id metasoChatId, kimi_chat_id kimiChatId, baidu_chat_id baiduChatId, zhzd_chat_id zhzdChatId, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%c-%d %H:%i:%s') createTime FROM wc_chat_history WHERE chat_id = #{chatId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wc_playwright_draft( id, task_id, user_prompt, draft_content, ai_name, user_name, share_url, share_img_url, create_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{taskId}, #{userPrompt}, #{draftContent}, #{aiName}, #{userName}, #{shareUrl}, #{shareImgUrl}, NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT wpd.task_id taskId, u.nick_name userName, u.avatar userAvatar, wpd.user_prompt question, DATE_FORMAT(wpd.create_time, '%Y-%c-%d %H:%i:%s') questionTime FROM wc_playwright_draft wpd LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON wpd.user_name = u.user_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND wpd.user_prompt LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyWord}, '%')
AND wpd.user_name = #{userId}
GROUP BY wpd.task_id ORDER BY wpd.create_time DESC

SELECT CASE ai_name WHEN 'deepseek' THEN 'DeepSeek' WHEN 'DeepSeek' THEN 'DeepSeek' WHEN '腾讯元宝' THEN '腾讯元宝' WHEN 'yuanbao' THEN '腾讯元宝' WHEN '豆包' THEN '豆包' WHEN '秘塔' THEN '秘塔' WHEN '百度' THEN '百度' WHEN '知乎直答' THEN '知乎直答' WHEN 'kimi' THEN 'Kimi' ELSE ai_name END name, draft_content content, share_img_url shareImgUrl, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%c-%d %H:%i:%s') responseTime, share_url shareUrl FROM wc_playwright_draft WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT draft_content FROM wc_playwright_draft WHERE user_name = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND (ai_name = #{aiName} OR ai_name = LOWER(#{aiName})) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
